changes.summary: Added NHTSA's final child-restraint rule with its delayed compliance dates, school-bus exemptions and explicitly projected costs and benefits.
Restored CDC's September 4 effective respiratory-disease reorganization from its September 9 publication without inferring undisclosed staffing or performance effects.
Added DOE's formal implementation inquiry for the bulk-power emergency without treating it as a product determination or removal order.
Added DHS's effective interim rule expanding the foreign-government-employee category and permanent-residence pathway while preserving the existing class injunction and unresolved merits.
